title: The store as a React hook
objective: See how `create` turns the vanilla store into a hook, how `useStore` bridges it to React via useSyncExternalStore, and why no Provider is needed.

quiz.prompt: Where do you put the `<Provider>` to make a zustand store available to components?

options.text: At the app root, like Redux’s <Provider store={store}>.
You don’t — the store is a module singleton you import; no Provider is required.

quiz.prompt: Why does reading state with `store.getState()` in a component body not cause the component to re-render on changes, while `store((s) => s.x)` does?
